intro: The China tourist visa (L visa) is for holidays, sightseeing and tours. British passport holders can currently visit China visa-free for short trips, so you need an L visa if your stay is longer, you want multiple entries, or you travel on another passport. We complete your application and book your visa centre appointment.
eligibility: Your trip is for tourism, sightseeing or visiting friends, not work or study
Your passport is valid for at least six months, with two blank visa pages
If you are not British, you hold valid UK residence status

sections.heading: Do you need a China tourist visa?
sections.text: British passport holders can visit China visa-free for up to 30 days until 31 December 2026. You need an L visa if you want to stay longer than 30 days in one visit, if you travel after the visa-free policy ends and it isn't extended, or if your passport isn't eligible for visa-free entry.

sections.heading: What the L visa application needs
sections.text: You'll usually need your passport, a completed online application form, a photo meeting Chinese visa rules, return flight bookings, hotel bookings for your whole stay or an invitation letter from a host, and proof of UK residence if you aren't British. Your fingerprints are taken at the visa centre.

sections.heading: Tips for a smooth application
sections.text: Make sure your itinerary, bookings and form all match. Leave plenty of time before travel, especially around Chinese New Year and summer. Our online China visa form reads your passport, fills in your details and lists exactly the documents your visa type needs.

sections.heading: China visa help in Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and help travellers and businesses across the North West and the rest of the UK. Most travel visa applications can be handled by post and email, so you don't need to visit us in person.

title: China Tourist Visa (L Visa) from the UK | Application Help
documents: Original passport, plus a copy of the photo page
Recent colour photo on a white background, meeting Chinese visa specifications
Hotel bookings for your whole stay, or an invitation letter if you’re staying with someone in China
Your UK visa or eVisa share code, if you are not British
Copies of any previous Chinese visas
description: China L visa help for UK residents who need one, and advice on visa-free travel for British citizens until 31 December 2026.

faqs.q: Do I need a visa for a holiday in China?
faqs.a: If you travel on a British passport, short holidays are currently visa-free. You need an L visa for longer stays, or if you travel on a passport that isn’t covered. We check the latest rules for your dates and passport before you book.

faqs.q: Do I need to attend the visa centre?
faqs.a: Yes. Most applicants give fingerprints in person at a Chinese Visa Application Service Centre. We book the appointment and prepare everything you take with you.

faqs.q: Can I get a multiple-entry tourist visa?
faqs.a: Often, yes, especially if you have visited China before. Tell us how often you plan to travel and we’ll advise on the best visa to request.

faqs.q: How long is a Chinese tourist visa valid?
faqs.a: It depends on what is granted, which can be single, double or multiple entry. Each stay is limited to the number of days printed on the visa.
